title: Refresh metrics on SessionStart and git-touching Bash commands

verified_files.detail: Command-gated wrapper. Judges each shell segment so 'cd /x && git merge' matches while 'echo git merge' does not, skips leading env assignments, imports sync_metrics lazily, and always exits 0.
Added a Bash PostToolUse matcher for sync_on_git.py, and sync_metrics.py on SessionStart ordered before session_start.py so the banner reads synced state.
10 tests across command classification, wrapper behaviour, failure tolerance, and hooks.json shape.

design_decisions.decision: A wrapper script rather than a matcher pattern.
design_decisions.why: Claude Code hook matchers match the tool name, not its arguments, so 'Bash but only git' is inexpressible in hooks.json. Without the wrapper a full sync would run on every ls, grep and python3 call.
A sync writes files. Triggering on `git status` or `git diff` would mean inspection mutates the working tree, surprising the user and dirtying diffs mid-review. The exclusion list is tested.

design_decisions.decision: main() catches everything and always exits 0.
design_decisions.why: A failing PostToolUse hook breaks the tool call that triggered it. This is an opportunistic refresh, not a gate -- the single biggest risk in the issue.
This hook runs on every Bash call; most do not need the sync machinery loaded.

definition_of_done.criterion: All tests pass; full suite green
hooks.json valid and declares the new entries in the right order
definition_of_done.evidence: json.load succeeds; test asserts the Bash matcher exists and sync_metrics.py precedes session_start.py under SessionStart

definition_of_done.criterion: A git command corrects a stale fixture; a non-git command leaves it byte-identical
definition_of_done.evidence: Fixture with a 999.0h stale Metrics block corrected to 2.0h/1.5h on 'git merge main'; unchanged on 'ls -la'

definition_of_done.criterion: Exits 0 on malformed stdin and on a raising sync
definition_of_done.evidence: Tested across '', 'not json', '{}', '{"tool_input":{}}', 'null', and a patched sync raising RuntimeError; live 'garbage' input also exits 0

definition_of_done.criterion: git status does not trigger a write
definition_of_done.evidence: Live: md5 of sprint-02.md unchanged after a 'git status --short' payload
'git merge main' payload synced correctly (Est=12.0h, Act=2.0h, Done=4/8); sprint-01 still reported as frozen

defects_closed: Metrics refreshed only on Edit/Write, so a git merge, PR merge or checkout left every status surface stale -- how this project's own status went stale when PRs #2 and #3 merged outside the workspace
SessionStart printed the banner from unsynced state
notes: hooks.json changes take effect in the plugin cache, so they need `/plugin update solorail` (or a reinstall) before the new SessionStart and Bash hooks actually fire for the user. The existing cache-staleness loose end now covers this file too.
